versions.changelog: v4.2: 四层记忆架构 (Identity→Working→Short-Term→Long-Term)。日志归档机制 (14天)。部署即验证硬规则 (改代码→部署→验证不过轮)。

v4.1: Deep History Retrieval (3-tier fallback: sessions_history → grep transcript → subagent scan). v4: Credential Index layer + multi-source credential scan + immediate credential persistence. Fixes 6/11 session history window overflow causing lost messages.

v3: startup gap detection — check STATE.md timestamp vs last session time, auto-sync if stale. Context loss recovery protocol (dont ask user, check sessions_history first). Fixes 2026-06-06 incident where agent forgot prior session fixes.
Initial release: log-as-truth agent memory system
